categories.label: Nigerian Meals
categories.blurb: The classics, cooked the way they should be: slow, generous and full of fire.

categories.label: Intercontinental
categories.blurb: Dishes from further afield, made fresh with the same kitchen discipline.

categories.label: Sides & Drinks
categories.blurb: Small plates, fresh smoothies and natural fruit drinks made in-house.

menu.name: Special Salad
menu.description: A fresh and delicious mix of crisp vegetables, colorful ingredients, and a creamy, flavorful dressing. Carefully prepared to deliver the perfect balance of freshness, crunch, and taste in every bite.

menu.name: Egusi Soup with Pounded Yam
menu.description: Rich melon-seed soup loaded with assorted meat and stockfish, served with soft, freshly pounded yam.

menu.name: Pepper Snails
menu.description: Thin-cut snail meat grilled over open flame, dusted with yaji spice, served with fresh onions and tomatoes.

menu.name: SeaFood Okro + Semo.
menu.description: A rich and flavorful seafood okro soup, loaded with fresh seafood and traditional Nigerian spices. Served with smooth, soft semolina (Semo) for the perfect taste of home in every bite.

menu.name: Ofada Rice with Ayamase
menu.description: Local ofada rice with the famous green-pepper designer stew, assorted meat and boiled egg.

menu.name: Boiled yam and Egg sauce
menu.description: Soft, perfectly boiled yam served with a rich, savory egg sauce made with fresh tomatoes, peppers, onions, and delicious spices. A simple, satisfying taste of home in every bite.

menu.name: Fried Rice and Beef/Plantain
menu.description: Flavorful, perfectly seasoned fried rice served with tender, juicy beef and sweet, golden-fried plantain. A delicious combination of savory goodness and irresistible sweetness in every bite.

menu.name: Vegetable Soup + Eba/Poundo/Semo
menu.description: A rich and delicious vegetable soup, packed with fresh leafy greens, flavorful spices, and tender assorted proteins. Served with your choice of soft Poundo, Eba, or Semo for a hearty and satisfying taste of home.

menu.name: Beans and Plantain
menu.description: Deliciously cooked beans seasoned with flavorful spices and served with sweet, golden-fried plantain. A hearty, comforting Nigerian classic that delivers the perfect balance of savory goodness and natural sweetness.

menu.name: GG Smash Burger and Fries
menu.description: Double-smashed beef patties, melted cheese and house sauce in a toasted brioche bun, with crispy fries.

menu.name: Chicken Shawarma Wrap
menu.description: Marinated chicken, crunchy vegetables and garlic cream rolled tight and toasted on the grill.

menu.name: Beef Stir-Fry Noodles
menu.description: Egg noodles flash-fried with strips of beef, spring onions and a glossy soy-ginger glaze.

menu.name: Triple-Stack Club Sandwich
menu.description: Three layers of toasted bread with grilled chicken, egg, cheese and fresh salad, served with fries.

menu.name: Barbecue Beef Short Ribs
menu.description: Slow-cooked short ribs brushed with a sticky barbecue glaze until they fall off the bone.

menu.name: Dodo (Fried Plantain)
menu.description: Sweet ripe plantain, deep-fried golden at the edges.

menu.name: Golden Spring Rolls
menu.description: Crisp vegetable spring rolls with a sweet-chilli dip.

menu.name: Classic Chapman
menu.description: The Lagos favourite: a tall, ice-cold mix of citrus, grenadine and bitters, finished with cucumber.

menu.name: Mango Pineapple Smoothie
menu.description: Fresh mango and pineapple blended in-house, nothing artificial.

menu.name: Iced Zobo
menu.description: Chilled hibiscus drink brewed with ginger and pineapple peel.
